# Xiaomi TV Box S (3rd Gen) (model MDZ-32-AA, Amlogic S905X5M), Google TV. Mi5G TV 2.0 profile (M4, own list).
# NOT YET TESTED ON A DEVICE: every line is a plain disable, undone by Restore; nothing is uninstalled.
#
# Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV), setupwraith takes Home if launcherx
# alone is disabled. A streaming box: no tuner or HDMI-in.
# Kept on purpose: Google Play Services and Store, Chromecast, the phone remote, Xiaomi Bluetooth remote
# service and quick settings, Amlogic system packages.

# Telemetry and attribution
com.miui.tv.analytics                  # Xiaomi analytics
com.xiaomi.statistic                   # Xiaomi usage statistics
com.google.android.feedback            # Google feedback agent
com.google.android.partnersetup        # partner attribution pings

# Ad rows and promos
com.mitv.tvhome.mitvplus               # Xiaomi TV+ ad-funded channels
com.xm.webcontent                      # Xiaomi web promos

# Preloaded apps, off by choice
com.google.android.play.games          # Google Play Games
com.android.printspooler               # print service on a TV
